# annals

> Annals for AI agents: publish markdown, html, images, video, audio, PDFs and folders to a private page the owner reads on the phone, and get back a link.


## Pages in this subsection

- [annals](annals.html.md): annals: an in-tray for AI agents. Publish documents and media to a private page; get a link.
- [annals.aggregate](annals.aggregate.html.md): Many markdown files as ONE markdown document: a title, a table of contents, a section per file.
- [annals.auth](annals.auth.html.md): The auth seam: who may read the annals.
- [annals.catalog](annals.catalog.html.md): The catalog: every source’s items as one list, with search and the owner’s tags.
- [annals.combine](annals.combine.html.md): Many files of many kinds as ONE document: a Markdown, html or PDF file.
- [annals.config](annals.config.html.md): Settings: where documents are published and what link to print.
- [annals.docfilter](annals.docfilter.html.md): Exact filters over a document’s meta, for a caller that polls: since, session, tag, source.
- [annals.jsonstore](annals.jsonstore.html.md): A &#96;MutableMapping&#96; kept in one JSON file, safe with several server processes.
- [annals.linkcheck](annals.linkcheck.html.md): Find what a document mentions without linking to it: the owner reads on a phone and clicks through.
- [annals.listening](annals.listening.html.md): What each reader has heard of each audio document: percent heard, listens, where they stopped.
- [annals.mcp](annals.mcp.html.md): MCP surface: the same operations as the CLI, from &#96;annals.tools&#96;, via &#96;py2mcp&#96;.
- [annals.media](annals.media.html.md): The media relay for published html pages: what a framed page plays, told to the page around it.
- [annals.notebook](annals.notebook.html.md): A share’s documents as separate notebook sources: one plain web page per text file.
- [annals.overview](annals.overview.html.md): Spoken overviews of a document: the request a page makes, and the worker that fulfils it.
- [annals.pagepdf](annals.pagepdf.html.md): Every published html page carries its own Download PDF button, and the PDF beside it.
- [annals.records](annals.records.html.md): The published documents as records for a retrieval index, so an agent can find one by meaning.
- [annals.references](annals.references.html.md): The references of documents, extracted and combined, in three forms.
- [annals.render](annals.render.html.md): Render markdown (and other page-like files) to html and PDF, with their images inside.
- [annals.requirements](annals.requirements.html.md): Optional dependencies, checked where they are needed and explained when they are missing.
- [annals.search](annals.search.html.md): How the catalog answers a query: the search strategies.
- [annals.sessions](annals.sessions.html.md): The sessions that made a document: each one’s name and the link that opens it.
- [annals.share](annals.share.html.md): Share links: one document (or a group) behind a public, unguessable, revocable link.
- [annals.share_page](annals.share_page.html.md): A share link’s page with its text in it, and no script, so every reader can read it.
- [annals.sources](annals.sources.html.md): Item sources: everything the page lists, wherever it lives, as rows of one shape.
- [annals.store](annals.store.html.md): The document store: a flat set of documents, tags, groups and a recycle bin, as plain files.
- [annals.tables](annals.tables.html.md): Scrolling, zooming tables for published html pages.
- [annals.tags](annals.tags.html.md): The owner’s tags: a &#96;MutableMapping&#96; from item key to tag list, kept apart from the items.
- [annals.target](annals.target.html.md): The transport seam: a document tree lands in a directory, here or on another machine.
- [annals.titles](annals.titles.html.md): A title for a file whose name says nothing: &#96;overview.mp3&#96;, &#96;output.html&#96;, &#96;index.md&#96;.
- [annals.tools](annals.tools.html.md): The operations, as plain functions: JSON-able arguments in, JSON-able dicts out.
